color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Priya · Security Analyst
owns fifteen concurrent reviews
wants the fleet to do the reading and the
chasing while she makes the judgement calls

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Elena · CISO
signs risk acceptances at G1
cares that every decision is defensible
and traceable months later

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Marcus · Procurement Manager
discovers the fleet in the Agent Registry,
kicks off reviews, watches cycle time
because a stalled review stalls a contract

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The vendor contact
receives the questionnaire, uploads evidence,
occasionally adversarial

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The auditor
never logs in — receives the binder.
The reason the observability layer exists

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Vendor Review Fleet v1.2
published, versioned and discoverable
in the Agent Registry

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
J6 · Legal finds the fleet in the Registry
and asks for access to run contract reviews

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Why the answer can be yes
identity scoping, gateway policy and per-agent least privilege
mean a second department gets its own scoped access —
not a copy of the system and not a shared credential.
Governance is what makes cross-department adoption safe,
and cross-department adoption is what the track asks for.

svg.text: Drawbridge — Who touches the fleet, and how a second department adopts it
